decisions.inputs: readantenna on a configuration file with absolute coordinates, no known observatory and no COFA header.
decisions.casa: readantenna averages the UTM branch's loop variables x, y, z instead of stnx, stny, stnz: UnboundLocalError for an XYZ file, the last antenna for a UTM file; it also swaps latitude and longitude from xyz2long.
decisions.ours: Converts the mean antenna position, as the code's comment intends (casa_simulation::readantenna).
decisions.rationale: The comment shows the observatory was meant to sit at the mean antenna position.
decisions.impact: Such configuration files work in casa-rs instead of raising or placing the observatory wrongly.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.inputs: readantenna on a configuration file with blank lines, e.g. CASA's own WSRT.cfg (two blank lines).
decisions.casa: A line with fewer than four values is skipped but still gets a default pad and antenna name, so readantenna returns 16 names for 14 WSRT antennas starting A00, A01, RT0.
decisions.rationale: Names must stay aligned with positions.
decisions.impact: CASA misnames every dish in a WSRT simulation; casa-rs does not.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.inputs: calc_pointings2 with maptype='ALMA' (or alma, ALMA-OT) and no primary beam (beam <= 0), e.g. simobserve with an ALMA map and no antenna list.
decisions.casa: The default spacing_asec*pbcoeff*sqrt(3) uses pbcoeff, a local of task_simobserve.py not defined in simutil.py, so the call raises NameError (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Uses simobserve's value 1.13 (PBCOEFF), so the beam is spacing x 1.13 x sqrt(3).
decisions.rationale: The default clearly intends simobserve's value.
decisions.impact: The call works instead of raising NameError.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `noisetemp` reads the wrong receiver temperature at the edges of its tables
decisions.inputs: noisetemp at exactly the first band edge (e.g. ALMA at 35 GHz, VLA 0.8-1 GHz, SMA 180 GHz) or above 900 GHz for an unknown telescope such as WSRT.
decisions.casa: The lookup leaves z=0 at the first edge so t0[-1] (the last entry) is used (230 K instead of 28 K for ALMA at 35 GHz), and for unknown telescopes the test reads f0[2] before checking z and raises IndexError (CASA 6.7.6, WSRT at 950 GHz).
decisions.ours: Takes the first temperature at the first edge and keeps the last temperature (200 K) above the last edge.
decisions.rationale: The lookup was meant to return the band's own receiver temperature.
decisions.impact: Receiver temperatures at band edges are right instead of wrapping around, and no IndexError.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `direction_splitter` cannot split a direction without an epoch
decisions.inputs: direction_splitter on a direction without an epoch, e.g. '18h00m00 -23d00m00'.
decisions.casa: It reads the longitude from field 1 and the latitude from field 2 whatever the count, so a direction without an epoch raises IndexError and an unmatched latitude raises AttributeError (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Refuses both with "can't interpret ... as a direction" (the message isdirection gives); more than three fields split as CASA splits them.
decisions.rationale: A clear error is better than a traceback.
decisions.impact: simobserve stops with a clear message instead of a traceback.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `modifymodel` swaps axes into place and refuses a cyclic order
decisions.inputs: modifymodel with a model whose axes are a cyclic order, e.g. [spectral, RA, Dec, Stokes].
decisions.casa: The swapaxes loop orders only transpositions (e.g. the FITS order), leaving a cyclic order out of place so the check raises "internal error: I'm confused about the shape if your model data cube" with the new image already created and empty (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Permutes the axes, so any order of the four is written as [RA, Dec, Stokes, spectral].
decisions.rationale: A model's axis order should not matter.
decisions.impact: Models in any axis order work; CASA refuses cyclic orders.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `modifymodel` labels the new image's Stokes planes by their count
decisions.inputs: modifymodel on a model labelled I and V, or on three unlabelled planes.
decisions.casa: The written image takes its Stokes axis from ia.fromshape's default, labelling planes by count (I, IQ, IQU, IQUV), so I and V comes out I and Q and the V data are read as Stokes Q; three unlabelled planes come out IQU though modifymodel returns 'IQV'.
decisions.ours: Keeps the model's labels and labels unlabelled planes as modifymodel reports them; circular or linear bases keep their labels, so flatimage and adding components refuse them.
decisions.rationale: modifymodel itself returns the model's Stokes labels.
decisions.impact: CASA mislabels non-I Stokes planes; casa-rs preserves them but refuses polarisation bases CASA relabels.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `modifymodel` indexes the map it makes of two cells
decisions.inputs: modifymodel with incell given as a list of two cells.
decisions.casa: incell = map(qa.convert, incell, ['arcsec','arcsec']) is then indexed as incell[0]; under Python 3 map returns an iterator, so it raises TypeError: 'map' object is not subscriptable (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Takes the two cells, converted to arcsec and used as given (signs included), as under Python 2; a single cell is unaffected.
decisions.rationale: The code was written for Python 2.
decisions.impact: A two-cell incell works instead of raising TypeError.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `ia.modify` converts a component spectrum through the image's default measures frame
decisions.inputs: ia.modify adding a component list to an image from ia.fromshape (as modifymodel and simobserve make), with spectra in a different frame, e.g. TOPO spectrum on an LSRK image.
decisions.casa: Each spectral model converts its reference frequency through the image's default measures frame (geocentre, epoch 0, J2000 pole), shifting frequencies by a velocity no observation has, about 1e-4 of the frequency in CASA 6.7.6.
decisions.ours: Converts when the image's conversion layer carries a real frame (epoch and observatory position) and otherwise takes the frequencies as they are.
decisions.rationale: A meaningful conversion needs the observation's epoch and position, which such a sky model does not carry.
decisions.impact: Frequencies and spectral-index fluxes differ from CASA by about 1e-4 on frame-mismatched components; matched frames agree to 1e-6.

decisions.record: `simutil.ismstp` takes any zero UVW value for total power
decisions.inputs: simobserve corrupting an existing MeasurementSet (obsmode='') whose first antenna name lacks 'TP' and which has more than one antenna.
decisions.casa: The test uvw.all() == 0. is true when any UVW value is zero, not all, so an interferometer MeasurementSet with one zero coordinate is corrupted as single dish with wrong file names and sensitivity constant.
decisions.ours: Tests whether every value is zero.
decisions.rationale: The test is meant to detect total power data.
decisions.impact: Interferometric data with one zero UVW value are handled as interferometry.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.
